question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: prepare maintain form succeed get influence should use be call Student life (a) ⎯⎯ the golden season of life. This (b) ⎯⎯ the time when we should (c) ⎯⎯ our selves for future.
